config.selection: Common validation score: normalized natural-value error plus even-head response error for all four factorial fits. Value-only control selects natural loss alone. Per-axis scales fixed using old natural discovery and new first128-row even-head response panel only. Include step zero. Freeze selected and fixed-step400/1600 factors before collecting final test.
config.controls: Same spectral rank64 start, natural-value training panel, mean, linear term, analytic intercept, minibatch size and total updates in all fits. Sample sizes nested. All-head fits distribute the same total response draws over nine heads rather than five; more unique sources does not mean more optimizer updates. Value-only control uses same natural objective and1600 steps.

predictions.text_coverage: Increasing128 to512 rows improves new-text response fidelity >=.05 at fixed source set; if it also improves odd heads in even-only fits, transfer is not purely missing-head coverage.
predictions.source_coverage: Adding odd heads improves new-text odd-head fidelity >=.05 at fixed row count; odd heads are unseen sources ONLY in even-only fits.
predictions.optimization: Compare fixed step400 vs1600, selected steps and train/validation gaps. Extra steps helping training but not validation argues against simply insufficient fitting.
predictions.payload_generalization: Gaussian same-head and isotropic payloads are excluded from all fitting. Actual-response improvements without payload improvements imply dependence on natural source-state correlations, not generic support reconstruction.

config.scope: Four fixed L8 axes; local response fidelity, not full-suffix behavior or whole-layer reconstruction. Rank64 means64 quadratic plus1 linear read per output. Text panels disjoint in continuation. All conditions and contrasts reported; no best-test selection.
